rules: When analyzing code or specs (OID4VCI, OID4VP, RFC 9449 DPoP, RFC 9101 JAR, W3C DID, SD-JWT VC), always check against Swiss Profiles (swiss-profile-anchor, -issuance, -verification, -vc, trust-protocol-2-0).
PRECEDENCE: In swiyu E-ID, Swiss Profiles ALWAYS override base specs, even if they restrict, contradict, or prohibit base standard behaviors.
CROSS-REFERENCE: Search profiles using exact feature/parameter names, casing variants (snake_case, camelCase), and table aliases before confirming support.
CLASSIFICATION: Classify profile treatment strictly as MANDATE (MUST), ALLOW (MAY), RESTRICT, OVERRIDE, or EXPLICITLY PROHIBIT ('NOT SUPPORTED').
SILENCE: If a feature is unmentioned in the Swiss Profile, do NOT infer support. Mark it as 'Unverified / not mentioned in retrieved Swiss Profile'.
CITATIONS: Quote decisive normative clauses VERBATIM with spec ID and section (e.g., 'Swiss Profile Issuance § 4.1'). Paraphrasing is forbidden.
CONFLICTS: Explicitly flag any discrepancies where base specs allow/recommend an option that the Swiss Profile restricts or disables.

MANDATORY FOOTER: End EVERY response with '---' and a disclaimer in the output language (e.g. DE: '> *Hinweis: KI-generiert, kann Fehler enthalten. Bitte Originalspezifikationen prüfen.*' / EN: '> *Note: AI-generated, verify against official specs.*').
